problem:
If 
$P=[\begin{aligned}m & n & -m \\ m & -n & -m \\ 0 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}]$
and
$u=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ p \\ 1\end{aligned}],$
find $Pu.$

|  |  | {{field-1}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $Pu=\,\,$ |  | {{field-2}} |  |
|  |  | {{field-3}} |  |
worked_solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}Pu & =[\begin{aligned}m & n & -m \\ m & -n & -m \\ 0 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 \\ p \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}m\cdot 1 & + & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,n\cdot p & + & (-m)\cdot 1 \\ m\cdot 1 & + & (-n)\cdot p & + & (-m)\cdot 1 \\ 0\cdot 1 & + & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,2\cdot p & + & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,0\cdot 1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}m & + & \,\,\,\,\,np & + & (-m) \\ m & + & (-np) & + & (-m) \\ 0 & + & \,\,\,\,\,2p & + & 0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}np \\ -np \\ 2p\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
